mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below its recent trend signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decreases below 4.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate crosses above 4.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling Federal Funds Rates below 4.5% and declining unemployment rates below 4.5% creates synergistic positive returns for the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market strengthening
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), an increase above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% during a tightening cycle but S&P 500 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 from its prior vintage value of 11247.6 signals stronger economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increased from 11247.6 in prior vintage
failure_condition: GDPC1 increases from prior vintage but S&P 500 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in UNRATE below 4.5% signals strong labor market conditions, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 4.5% but S&P 500 5d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Low Federal Funds Rates below 4.5% combined with elevated supply (INDPRO above 110.269) create a positive feedback loop, driving S&P 500 returns upwards over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and INDPRO > 110.269 but S&P 500 60d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven expansion (INDPRO above 110.269 and FEDFUNDS below 4.5%), elevated supply and monetary easing create positive feedback, driving S&P 500 returns upwards over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 110.269 and FEDFUNDS <4.5% but S&P 500 60d returns are negative.
